description: This file defines a Gradle plugin in Kotlin that sets up Android Lint configurations following certain conventions. It applies different configurations based on whether the project is an application, a library, or other, and configures specific lint reporting options.

classes.name: AndroidLintConventionPlugin
classes.description: A Gradle plugin class that configures Android Lint settings based on project plugins.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies lint configurations depending on whether the project is an Android application or library, or applies default lint settings.
